content.text:
The rule is:

1. Treat the grid as a 3×3 array of 5×5 compartments separated by 7-valued lines.
2. Collect every position within a compartment that contains a 9 in any compartment.
3. In every compartment, place a 7 at all those corresponding positions.
4. Preserve the original 9s; separator lines remain unchanged.

In this example, the union of the 9-patterns is a plus shape, so every compartment receives the plus-shaped 7 pattern, with existing 9s overriding the added 7s.
